title: Grand Theft Auto III: Definitive Edition
subtitle: Early OCR practice profile for a platinum and 100% route. Package counts self-correct; mission, Rampage, jump, and vehicle-delivery banners are tracked independently.
collectibleDescription: The 100 hidden packages, 20 rampages, and 20 unique jumps required for 100% completion.
rules: No cheats while trophy tracking is active
Complete Portland mission chains before their lockout points
Do not leave Kingdom Come as the final 100% requirement
Keep a backup save before the final D-Ice missions
